name: md-to-docx-windows
description: Local-first Markdown to Word desktop application for Windows 11

scripts.dist:win: node scripts/generate-appx-assets.cjs && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never && node scripts/smoke-installer.mjs
scripts.dist:store:x64: node scripts/generate-appx-assets.cjs && electron-builder --win appx --x64 --publish never --config.directories.output=../release/store && node scripts/smoke-store.mjs x64
scripts.dist:store:arm64: node scripts/generate-appx-assets.cjs && electron-builder --win appx --arm64 --publish never --config.directories.output=../release/store && node scripts/smoke-store.mjs arm64
scripts.dist:store: node scripts/generate-appx-assets.cjs && electron-builder --win appx --x64 --arm64 --publish never --config.directories.output=../release/store && node scripts/smoke-store.mjs x64 arm64
